title: One selected row of the product interchange grid
statement: For finite A and two diagrams d1,d2 [def-pur-etale-graph-interchange-data], choose either index n. Use the three pairwise product maps lambda_f,n,lambda_g,n,lambda_h,n [lem-pur-etale-pairwise-product-graph-normalization] and the fixed productInterchange U [def-pur-etale-graph-product-interchange]. Then I_n followed by lambda_h,n equals lambda_f,n whiskered on the right by the middle functor of d_n, followed by lambda_g,n whiskered on the left by the product source functor, followed by U. This is one row of the common grid; it makes no comparison between I1 and I2 and uses no auxiliary compactification cf or ch.

proof.text: Factor each selected pairwise lambda into its Cartesian proper-ambient factor a and its inverse graph-triangle/open-compositor factor s. This is the explicit word equality ProductRow.lambda_factor, proved by unfolding the displayed lambda and reassociating its isomorphisms. The intermediate presentations have the three selected supporting neighborhoods as supports and the same proper ambient products as the final product presentations.

proof.text: Substitute the two identities in I_n a_h s_h. Naturality (whiskerLeft_comp_whiskerRight) moves a_g past s_f. Whiskering preserves composition, so a_f s_f and a_g s_g are the full source and middle lambdas. Reassociation gives I_n lambda_h = (lambda_f whiskered by G_n)(lambda_g whiskered by F) U. Perform the two dependent Boolean cases; each has the original unchanged statement.

lean.statement: theorem etaleGraphProductRowPasting (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (d₁ d₂ : EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram f g) (second : Bool) : (etaleGraphDiagramInterchange A (if second then d₂ else d₁)).hom ≫ (d₁.productCompositeLambda d₂ A second).hom = Functor.whiskerRight (d₁.productSourceLambda d₂ A second).hom ((EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification (if second then d₂ else d₁).compactification).functor A) ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft ((d₁.productF d₂).functor A) (d₁.productMiddleLambda d₂ A second).hom ≫ (d₁.productInterchange d₂ A).hom
